Write plain Markdown on one side and watch a beautiful page appear on the other.
SharkDown is a Markdown editor for Mac, iPad and iPhone with a live preview, themes you can design yourself, and tools that do the tedious parts for you.
Write!
* Syntax-highlighted editor with a live preview that scrolls along with you
* Side by side on Mac and iPad, resizable and collapsible; one tap between editor and preview on iPhone
* Tables, task lists and strikethrough, plus footnotes with the GitHub-compatible engine
* Format toolbar for headings, bold, italic, links, images, lists, quotes, tables and code
Make it yours!
* Eight built-in themes, from clean Shark to green-on-black Term and serif Paper
* Sixteen code-highlighting themes
* Theme Builder: pick colours, fonts, sizes and layout with a live light and dark preview, or add your own CSS
Smart Tools!
Select some text and the wand suggests what fits.
* Turn CSV, JSON or columns into tables, sort and tidy them, and add total and average rows that stay up to date
* A table of contents that keeps itself current, an outline to jump around, heading-level fixes and a link checker
* Lists, links from URLs, code blocks with the language detected, title and sentence case, calculations and Fix Markdown
Smart Tools work instantly on every device.
AI, on your device!

With Apple Intelligence, SharkDown can proofread, summarize, shorten, expand, change tone, translate, explain, pull out key points and action items, build tables from loose text and suggest a file name.
It runs on your device, and numbers are always calculated, never guessed.
AI tools appear on devices and in regions where Apple Intelligence is available.
Everywhere!
* Documents live in iCloud Drive and save as you type
* Handoff between iPhone, iPad and Mac, and edits on one device show up live on another
* Version history on every device
* Themes and preferences sync through iCloud
* Quick Look previews in Finder and Files, in your theme
Share!
* Export self-contained HTML or paginated PDF, and print on Mac

Privacy note
Your documents stay yours: on your device, or in your own iCloud. AI runs on your device. The app developer does not receive, store, or have access to any of your data.
